text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Left step, right, left step, then the 
excitement pose. ...Oh, this? It's a 
choreography video for the back dancers.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Just in case I end up being a backup 
dancer. Dancing with all my might, and 
doing it flawlessly... Being prepared like 
this is crucial. Understand?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Royce-chan, you're so admirable!! Next 
time you'll definitely take center stage! 
We're rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—That's right, we'll win the fans' hearts 
with the concert! Fufufu, I can memorize 
the choreography in just one look, so it's 
time-efficient too... See, isn't it a 
flawless plan?”
